definitions.explanation: All matters and aspects of a given situation. Most commonly used in the expression 準備万端 (fully prepared), meaning everything is ready.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}{万端|ばんたん}だ。
{準備|じゅんび}{万端|ばんたん}{整|ととの}えて{出発|しゅっぱつ}した。
examples.english: We set off with everything fully prepared.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}の{準備|じゅんび}は{万端|ばんたん}{抜|ぬ}かりなく{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: Preparations for the ceremony are proceeding thoroughly without any oversights.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the expression {準備|じゅんび}{万端|ばんたん} (fully prepared, all preparations complete). Can also appear with {整|ととの}える (to arrange, to put in order). A somewhat formal expression conveying thoroughness and completeness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備|じゅんび}{万端|ばんたん} (fully prepared)
- {万端|ばんたん}{整|ととの}う (everything is in order)
- {万端|ばんたん}{抜|ぬ}かりない (thorough without any oversights)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {万全|ばんぜん}: perfect, complete — used in {万全|ばんぜん}の{態勢|たいせい} (perfect readiness)
- {完璧|かんぺき}: perfect — emphasizes flawlessness
